name: Sticker Collector
text:
{T}: Untap another target permanent.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, exile target creature you control, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
Protection from odd mana values
Sacrifice this permanent: Draw two cards.
{T}: The next time target player would roll one or more dice this turn, instead they roll that many dice plus one, then you choose one of those rolls to ignore.
Whenever this creature attacks, proliferate.
Stickers are not removed from this card after the game ends. Yap.
